notes:
### New

- **Battery check results.** After a quick battery test the app tells you in plain words how your battery did. If a result looks low, it suggests testing again or contacting Tescom support. Every result is kept in the new Tests tab.
- **Send diagnostics to Tescom.** From a UPS's Tests tab, send our support team what they need in one step. You see what's included before sending, you get a reference number, and the reports you sent stay listed in the app.
- **Home Assistant.** Show the UPS on this computer in Home Assistant, with its battery, load and power status. No cloud plan needed.
- **A year of history.** Your UPS's readings are kept for up to 12 months, even while the app is closed (macOS and Linux for now). See voltage, load, battery and power cuts over any period.
- **Activity.** The power cuts, battery tests and alarms of the last 30 days, for every UPS on this computer, in one list.
- **Leo SmartBox battery test.** The SmartBox now runs its own short battery test.

### Improved

- **Simpler UPS page.** Every UPS has a Battery test button, and only the actions that work on your model, such as turning it off or muting the alarm.
- **Clearer settings.** A UPS's settings read as a plain list, in everyday words and units.
- **No more typing serial numbers.** The serial number comes from your myTescom account when you activate the UPS.
- **Settings that keep up.** When we improve the settings for your UPS model, the app offers to apply them.

### Fixed

- The cloud agent now starts properly on macOS and Linux after you turn it on.
- History no longer says "No history" for a UPS that was added recently.
- Smaller fixes in Preferences, the dashboard and the sidebar.
